paper_metadata.title: High temperature mechanical behaviour of Mg–6Zn–1Y alloy with 1 wt.% calcium addition: Reinforcing effect due to I-(Mg3Zn6Y1) and Mg6Zn3Ca2 phases

evidence.quote: The influence of small calcium additions on the high-temperature mechanical behaviour in an extruded Mg–6Zn–1Y (wt.%) alloy reinforced by the I-phase has been investigated.
This alloy was modified by adding 1% of calcium with a nominal composition of Mg–6Zn–1Y–1Ca (wt.%) and it was designated as ZW61Ca.
The inﬂuence of calcium addition to the ternary Mg–6Zn–1Y alloy on the mechanical properties at high temperatures has been studied.
However, the present study evidences that calcium addition improves noticeably the mechanical properties of the ternary alloy in the temperature range 100–300 °C ( Fig. 2 c).
